summary.content:
Today's selection covers 94 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meta A.I. Bug Allowed Hackers to Take Over Instagram Accounts
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA gives feds 3 days to patch Check Point VPN bug exploited as zero-day
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 67 articles published in the last 24 hours
